guidance_accountability_matrix_a.guided_metric: Network Infrastructure Constant Currency Sales Growth
guidance_accountability_matrix_a.prior_quarter_guidance: +10% to +12% constant currency growth for FY26
guidance_accountability_matrix_a.reported_q0_actual: Network Infrastructure grew +15% CC (+17% reported) to €2,158M in Q3
guidance_accountability_matrix_a.variance_commentary: Significantly beat prior growth expectations fueled by IP Networks surging +43% CC and Optical Networks growing +18% CC on hyperscaler AI data center buildouts.

guidance_accountability_matrix_a.prior_quarter_guidance: EUR 2.1 billion to EUR 2.6 billion full-year guidance range
guidance_accountability_matrix_a.reported_q0_actual: Q3 Comparable Operating Profit surged +35% YoY to €605M (11.7% margin); 9M reached €1,340M (+31% YoY)
guidance_accountability_matrix_a.variance_commentary: Firmly on track to deliver full-year operating profit above the midpoint of the €2.1B-€2.6B outlook, supported by strong Q4 seasonal operating leverage.

guidance_accountability_matrix_a.prior_quarter_guidance: Deliver EUR 200 million net synergies run-rate by end of 2027
guidance_accountability_matrix_a.reported_q0_actual: Integration accelerated to complete by end of 2026 with full EUR 200M net synergies
guidance_accountability_matrix_a.variance_commentary: CEO Justin Hotard confirmed integration is tracking one full year ahead of initial plan, accelerating optical portfolio simplification and cost reductions.

guidance_accountability_matrix_a.guided_metric: Free Cash Flow Conversion from Comparable Operating Profit
guidance_accountability_matrix_a.prior_quarter_guidance: 45% to 65% cash conversion from comparable operating profit
guidance_accountability_matrix_a.reported_q0_actual: Lowered guidance corridor to 35% to 55%; Q3 reported FCF was -€99M
guidance_accountability_matrix_a.variance_commentary: Lowered conversion guidance due to €400M strategic working capital investment to buffer optical components for 2027 growth and accelerated restructuring cash outflows (€800M-€900M FY).

forward_guidance_reset_matrix_b.new_management_guidance: Reaffirmed EUR 2.1B to EUR 2.6B; explicitly guides Q4 to deliver above midpoint
forward_guidance_reset_matrix_b.delta_vs_street: In-line to slightly above consensus (€2.38B implied midpoint)
forward_guidance_reset_matrix_b.rationale: Strong optical/IP operating leverage and cost discipline offset macro hesitation in select legacy European mobile networks.

forward_guidance_reset_matrix_b.new_management_guidance: Assumes +20% to +24% QoQ net sales increase in Q4 (implies €6,185M to €6,391M)
forward_guidance_reset_matrix_b.rationale: Supported by €1.5B in Q3 AI & Cloud order intake (+118% YoY) and scheduled year-end optical network deployments.

forward_guidance_reset_matrix_b.forward_horizon_and_metric: Network Infrastructure Full-Year Net Sales Growth
forward_guidance_reset_matrix_b.new_management_guidance: Upgraded assumption to 12% to 14% constant currency growth for FY26
forward_guidance_reset_matrix_b.delta_vs_street: +200 bps guidance upgrade across FY26 run-rate
forward_guidance_reset_matrix_b.rationale: Combined Optical and IP Networks outperforming prior 18%-20% assumption; hyperscaler demand accelerating into 2027.

forward_guidance_reset_matrix_b.new_management_guidance: Reduced assumption to EUR 750 million to EUR 850 million
forward_guidance_reset_matrix_b.rationale: Real estate footprint rationalization and shifting timing of certain optical manufacturing equipment cash payments into early 2027.

forward_guidance_reset_matrix_b.forward_horizon_and_metric: Free Cash Flow Conversion from Comparable Operating Profit
forward_guidance_reset_matrix_b.new_management_guidance: Lowered to 35% to 55% (~€800M to €1.30B FY26 FCF)
forward_guidance_reset_matrix_b.delta_vs_street: -1,000 bps reduction at lower bound (~€150M cash headwind)
forward_guidance_reset_matrix_b.rationale: Committed €400M additional working capital to secure optical transceivers and components ahead of 2027 AI interconnect ramp.

call_qa_forensic_highlights.question_focus: Hyperscaler AI & Cloud order momentum durability (+118% order intake), pipeline visibility, and confidence in 25%-30% combined Optical & IP growth in 2027.
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_response: CEO Justin Hotard explained that cloud hyperscalers are moving from proof-of-concept testing to wide-scale distributed AI data center interconnects. He highlighted the Google €13B Finland partnership as validation of Nokia's differentiated coherent optical switching and routing silicon, confirming high conviction in 25%-30% growth for 2027.
call_qa_forensic_highlights.forensic_assessment: High conviction; management demonstrated firm pricing power and proprietary DSP silicon advantages without discounting to hyperscalers.

call_qa_forensic_highlights.question_focus: Mobile Infrastructure margin sustainability, the degree of revenue pull-forward from Q4 into Q3, and outlook for 5G radio network upgrades.
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_response: CFO Marco Wirén noted that while roughly €60M-€80M of Mobile Infrastructure revenue was accelerated into Q3 due to carrier deployment milestones, structural gross margins (47.5%) and commercial discipline remain intact. Radio Networks grew +11% reported, benefiting from the global cost-reduction program.
call_qa_forensic_highlights.forensic_assessment: Realistic calibration; indicates Q4 Mobile Infrastructure operating margins will normalize toward 12%-13% as revenue mix normalizes.

call_qa_forensic_highlights.question_focus: Rationale for lowering full-year FCF conversion guidance to 35%-55%, negative Q3 FCF (-€99M), and inventory obsolescence risks associated with the €400M working capital build.
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_response: Justin Hotard and Marco Wirén emphasized that 85%+ of the €400M working capital investment is tied to pre-ordered optical transceivers, coherent line cards, and switching ASICs required for locked-in 2027 customer deliveries. Working capital is planned to normalize as deployments roll out.
call_qa_forensic_highlights.forensic_assessment: Reassuring; the inventory build is customer-order-backed rather than speculative stock, though cash flow timing pushes recovery into 2027.
